blockers.observation: Repository rulesets collection returned empty on 2026-09-29; branch-protection read is unavailable to the installed GitHub App because it lacks administration permission.
blockers.resolution: Enable GitHub-level main protection/ruleset with required immutable acceptance checks, PR-only updates, no force-push/deletion, minimal documented bypass.

nonBlockingDeferred.rationale: Physical-mobile HSME validation was explicitly removed from the BERS v1 release gate; the work remains open research and gains no production authority.

selectionLaw: BERS_V1_RC may be assigned only when blockers is empty, rcSelectable is true, and rcCoordinate is one exact accepted main SHA with mandatory release evidence green. Deferred post-v1 HSME research must remain non-production unless separately promoted by later reviewed evidence.
